stem: Ana can type a report in 2 hours. Bea can type the same report in 3 hours. If they work together, how many minutes will it take them?
hints: Working together is faster than either one alone, so the answer is less than 2 hours (120 minutes).
Ana types 1/2 of the report per hour. Bea types 1/3 of it per hour. Add these rates.
1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6. Flip the sum to get the time in hours, then multiply by 60 for minutes.

solution.methodName: Work rates: rate = 1 ÷ time, then add the rates

steps.action: Let t = the time, in hours, for Ana and Bea working together.
Ana's rate: 1/2 of the report per hour. Bea's rate: 1/3 of the report per hour.
Add the rates: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6 of the report per hour.
steps.why: To add fractions, give them the same bottom number. 6 works for both 2 and 3.
Dividing by a fraction is the same as multiplying by it flipped: 1 × 6/5.

steps.action: Check: in 6/5 hours Ana types 6/5 × 1/2 = 3/5 and Bea types 6/5 × 1/3 = 2/5 of the report. 3/5 + 2/5 = 1 whole report. It takes 72 minutes.

trapNotes.50 minutes: This is 5/6 of an hour, their combined rate. You forgot to flip it: time = 1 ÷ 5/6 = 6/5 hours.
trapNotes.150 minutes: This is the average of 2 and 3 hours (2 1/2 hours). Working together must be faster than Ana alone (2 hours).
trapNotes.300 minutes: This adds the times: 2 + 3 = 5 hours. Add the rates, not the hours.
